acceptable_visual_variants: A simple, solemn walk of a person or group under a hot sun
A symbolic representation of a final journey with barricades in the background
cultural_entities.gloss: Literally 'final journey', a culturally specific Hindi term commonly used to refer to a funeral procession or a person's final journey after death. In this context, it carries both the literal sense of a physical final journey under duress and the cultural weight of a funeral procession.
visual_features: A body being carried or moving slowly
A path under a harsh sun

annotation.emotional_arc: grief and physical exhaustion to quiet acceptance and resilience

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The final stage of life, approaching death or the end of a journey.
acceptable_visual_variants: A lone silhouette walking toward a soft, fading horizon line.
A path that gradually dissolves into mist or light.
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: The last physical trip or funeral procession.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: An illustrator might literally depict a funeral procession or a physical traveler walking down a road, which misses the internal, existential transition of the speaker.
metaphor_spans.tenor: The transition to death or the end of life
metaphor_spans.vehicle: A physical journey or final trip
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a solitary figure walking toward a horizon where the path fades into light or mist, avoiding overly literal funeral imagery.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation of 'घेराबंदी' (gherabandi) as 'barricades' loses the active, surrounding sense of encirclement or siege inherent in the Hindi term, which implies being trapped or cordoned off rather than just encountering physical obstacles.

The phrase 'सिमटती हुई दूरी' (simatti hui doori) carries a nuanced sense of distance shrinking, folding, or wrapping itself up, which is flattened into the more literal 'shrinking distance' in English.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The repetitive, circular nature of memories that keep returning to the mind.
acceptable_visual_variants: Swirling, circular ripples of light surrounding a central figure.
A circular halo of soft, translucent, overlapping scenes from the past.
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: A physical wheel or circular object made of memories.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting a literal physical wheel with pictures or memories pasted on it could look cartoonish or overly literal.

transferred_attributes: ability to trap or hold back

metaphor_spans.tenor: The recurring and persistent nature of memories
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Show a figure surrounded by swirling, circular patterns of light or faint, overlapping translucent images of past events.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The course, experiences, and inevitable progression of human life.
acceptable_visual_variants: A winding path extending into a vast, open landscape under a changing sky.
A single track leading forward through contrasting terrains of light and shadow.
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: A physical road or path that belongs to life.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: An illustrator might draw a literal highway or dirt road with a signpost saying 'Life', which is cliché and overly literal.
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation: This is the path of life
metaphor_spans.tenor: The course and progression of human existence
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a long, winding path stretching forward into an open, unknown landscape, symbolizing the journey of existence.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation of 'उसकी आवाज़ें' (uski aawazein) as 'Their voices' shifts the singular possessive pronoun 'उसकी' (which could refer to a singular 'whoever' or a singular collective entity left behind) to a plural 'Their', altering the grammatical number and personal focus.
The translation of 'सुनाई देती हैं' (sunai deti hain) as 'echo' changes a passive sensory experience ('are heard' or 'make themselves heard') into an active acoustic phenomenon ('echo').

annotation.theme: The inevitable final journey of life amidst physical decay and lingering memories

original_poem:
सभी रास्ते अब बंद हैं,  
अंतिम यात्रा का समय है,  
गर्मी की धूप में,  
बंदूकें और घेराबंदी,  
मेरा शरीर अब भारी है,  
हर कदम में सिमटती हुई दूरी।  

जो भी पीछे रह गया,  
उसकी आवाज़ें सुनाई देती हैं,  
कभी-कभी यादों का चक्र,  
मुझे रोक लेता है,  
लेकिन आगे बढ़ना है,  
जीवन का यही मार्ग है।
translated_poem:
Final Journey  
All paths are now closed,  
It is the time for the final journey,  
In the heat of the sun,  
Guns and barricades,  
My body is now heavy,  
Every step is a shrinking distance.  

Whoever was left behind,  
Their voices echo,  
Sometimes the cycle of memories,  
Stops me,  
But I must move forward,  
This is the path of life.
